description: A 4 by 4 matrix mixer: every input can be sent to every output at its own level, with a modulation jack and attenuator for each of the 16 levels

params.text: Sets how much of that input goes into that output, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the jack above it before it is added to that level knob, 0 to 100 per cent

inputs.text: One of the 4 signals to be mixed, one channel per voice
Modulates that one level, a tenth per volt scaled by the attenuator below it and added to the knob

outputs.text: Carries the sum of the 4 inputs at the levels set down its column

notes: an output with no cable in it is not computed at all, and an input with no cable counts as silence
a level and its modulation are added and then held between 0 and 1, so modulation cannot turn a signal upside down and cannot push a level past full
a modulation jack is passed over while its attenuator is at zero, so the attenuator has to be opened before the cable does anything
